title: A guest who RSVPs without an account gets a follow-up that invites them to become a Member

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail:
WORKSTREAM 6 of the launch brief (ADR-1720), the invite loop. TODAY: guest RSVP works (app/(main)/events/guest-rsvp-actions.ts, capture_guest_rsvp), sends a receipt (lib/events/guest-rsvp-email.ts) and reminders (app/api/cron/event-reminders/route.ts), and writes a lead with source event_rsvp. But RECOVERY_EXCLUDED_SOURCES = [event_rsvp] (lib/crm/lead-sources.ts:33) keeps those leads out of the only follow-up mailer, so nothing turns a guest into a Member. THE FIX: a guest follow-up sequence after the gathering (or a set number of days after RSVP) with one button to claim their seat history and join; it stops the moment the guest signs up (convert_signup_leads_for_me). Respects unsubscribe and the send gate. Member-facing: needs a help line and changelog entry.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. A new hourly cron, app/api/cron/event-followups, finds events whose end (ends_at, else start plus two hours, read in the event zone) fell 2 to 26 hours ago and emails each guest once: guest RSVPs that are going and not pending, plus guest ticket holders. sendGuestFollowUpEmail (lib/email.ts) thanks them and offers one Join free button, a /sign-in link carrying the address, the same account offer the ticket receipt uses. The queue dedupe key guest-followup:<event>:<email> keeps it to one send, so no migration. Suppressed addresses are skipped. Registered in vercel.json, the hourly freshness window and CRON_UNMONITORED (the 20 monitor checks are taken), and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Help line in getting-started/how-to-rsvp, changelog entry. LIVE-803 adds the Did you make it? check-in to this same cron.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-802";const crons=walk("app/api/cron").filter(f=>/route\.ts$/.test(f)&&/guest/i.test(r(f))&&/(follow.?up|become a member|join)/i.test(r(f))&&!/event-reminders/.test(f));if(!crons.length)fail(ID+": no cron sends guests a follow-up to become a Member");const v=r("vercel.json");if(!crons.some(f=>v.includes("/"+p.dirname(f).replace(/^app\//,""))))fail(ID+": the guest follow-up route is not scheduled in vercel.json")'
verify.note: Fails while no scheduled cron, other than the reminder, follows up a guest RSVP with an invitation to join.
